Sandbox_waterWorks_EnableNetworkContextA: Shows player-facing water-network selection, connection, transfer, treatment, and related context actions. Disabling it does not delete networks or stop existing schedules.
Sandbox_waterWorks_EnableNetworkInspecti: Shows the read-only Inspect Water Network action for registered endpoints.
Sandbox_waterWorks_EnableCustomTransferA: Adds the custom decimal amount entry alongside the bounded transfer presets.
Sandbox_waterWorks_EnableScheduledTransf: Shows controls for creating, updating, and cancelling recurring transfers. Disabling this UI does not cancel schedules that already exist.
Sandbox_waterWorks_EnableWaterSampling_t: Allows visual water inspection and reagent-based quality testing. Disabling it removes the world context actions and test-kit loot injection.
Sandbox_waterWorks_SamplingTimeMultiplie: Multiplies the duration of visual inspection and test-kit sampling actions.
Sandbox_waterWorks_WaterTestKitLootChanc: Independent chance for an eligible laboratory, medical, pharmacy, hospital, or camping container to receive a Water Test Kit.
